name: Expanse

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Current product discovers idle GPU capacity in customer fleets; savings statistics are not an instance tariff. No standalone managed GPU rental established. Retain marginal software/operator lead.
Inventory exclusion: customer GPU utilization software. Card contains no numeric compute modes and no selectable price plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

2026-09-29: Expanse is software that predicts HPC/AI job resources (memory, runtime, failure risk) and diagnoses failures. It runs alongside SLURM/Kubernetes/Nomad on the customer's own cluster and sells no compute. /pricing has no pricing page (it serves the homepage), and the only CTA is 'Book a discovery call'. Keep it out of compute rankings.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.note: Not applicable: Expanse is self-hosted job-prediction software (Analyse/Diagnose) installed on the customer's own SLURM/Kubernetes/Nomad cluster; it provides no machines/sandboxes, so it has no such feature.

usage_api.note: granularity: none; cost: no; Expanse is self-hosted software (not a sandbox provider). Usage tracking is the responsibility of the customer's underlying cluster scheduler, not Expanse.
